source_hash_meaning: source_sha256 is the original frozen local archive file bytes; source_git_blob_sha256 separately records the source commit blob because historical Git checkout newline conversion can differ. Publication attributes preserve all published file bytes.
purpose: Public export provenance; independent of the historical scientific seals.
historical_receipts: Earlier seals, artifact manifests, receipts and run logs describe the original local archive. Redacted files no longer satisfy those original byte chains. Use recovery_manifest.json for portable frozen inference.
scientific_changes: No retraining, recalibration, threshold selection, or changes to the archived scientific results.
publication_changes: New portable recovery, dependency and licensing documentation; machine paths and private author emails redacted; ZIP redaction; report attribution links.
self_hash: Excluded to avoid recursion; the Git commit binds this manifest.
